correctness.rationale: For p in (0,1), s in (0,1], B>0, all k≥1, the objective is a finite expectation of log[s(1-g)+Bg K/k]. Strict second-derivative negativity and endpoint derivatives establish unique boundaries. The leave-one-out conditional Jensen argument rigorously gives strict derivative ordering at fixed g>0, hence strict optimizer monotonicity. At interior optima sE(1/R)=1; splitting K=0 and using Chernoff concentration on 0<K<kp/2 proves the exact asymptotic constant. Exact 1/3 and 1/sqrt(3) examples and 1,012 rational inequalities plus 60 arbitrary-precision roots were reproduced from the standalone package. Finite numerical checks are not substitutes for the universal proof.

originality.rationale: Four targeted research-record queries, exact title/alias searches, and comparison with close ecological primary literature identify the classic Cohen germination optimum and spatial risk-spreading principles as prior art. The new claim is the strict optimizer ordering for each successive count of independent, fully mixed patches, finite-patch interiority and exact all-patches-fail exponential reserve coefficient. These do not follow from the inspected statements about fixed-strategy geometric mean benefits or optimal dispersal length. Strongest full-text access gaps are explicitly retained as residual risks rather than treated as novelty evidence.
residual_risks: Bascompte et al. 2002 OA PDF failed to load; its main theorem is known from its abstract, but appendices and exact specializations are not fully checked.
Klinkhamer et al. 1987 and Cohen–Levin 1987 were only partially accessible through indexed excerpts; an explicit identical special case could have been overlooked.
Cohen 1966 original full text was not directly read; only its classical single-environment result was compared.
A semantic research index and scoped ledger deduplication cannot prove global uniqueness.
The model is deliberately simplified, and the rare-event prefactor may be derivable via general Kelly-portfolio arguments not located in the checked literature.

value.rationale: The ecological conflict of dispersal in space versus seed dormancy in time is a literature-motivated model-selection problem. The theorem completely characterizes an integer family of growth-optimal germination policies and identifies an unexpected nonzero finite-patch seed reserve with precise all-patch-catastrophe exponential scale, not simply a direction-of-change derivative or reparameterization of one-patch Cohen bet hedging. This exact reserve scaling is needed to quantify diminishing marginal importance of dormant insurance as patches become independent and numerous. No empirical efficacy or broad-network result is implied.
